meaning: Supabase Storage cannot find a bucket with the name in your code, or the current user is not allowed to see it.
causes: The bucket was never created in this project (the AI wrote upload code but did not create the bucket).
Bucket name typo or case difference (Avatars vs avatars).
The app is pointed at a different Supabase project.
A public URL is used for a private bucket, or RLS on storage.objects blocks the request.

steps.text: Storage > New bucket: create it with the exact name the code uses. Tick Public only if files should be readable by anyone with the link.

steps.code: insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public) values ('avatars', 'avatars', true);

steps.text: Add policies so logged-in users can upload into their own folder.
Upload to a path that starts with the user id.
For private buckets, show files with createSignedUrl() instead of getPublicUrl().

prompt: Uploads fail with 'Bucket not found'. Give me SQL that creates the '<BUCKET>' bucket (public: <true/false>) and storage.objects RLS policies letting authenticated users insert, update and read files only under a folder named with their auth.uid(). Update the upload code to use the path `${user.id}/filename` and use createSignedUrl if the bucket is private.

faq.a: Usually RLS on storage.objects or a private bucket accessed via a public URL; Storage hides buckets you may not access.
Not with the anon key by default. Create buckets in the dashboard or a migration.
